intended_comparison: CDLM objectives adapted to IDLM MDLM on TinyGSM, preserving the MMD data and confidence-threshold GSM8K comparison protocol.

paper.title: CDLM: Consistency Diffusion Language Models for Faster Sampling

objective.distillation: Forward teacher-to-student cross entropy on positions newly revealed between the sampled trajectory state and window endpoint; teacher entropy is omitted as a constant.
objective.self_consistency: Forward cross entropy from detached current-student probabilities at the later state to student predictions at the earlier state, on positions masked in both states.
objective.ground_truth: Inverse-mask-probability-weighted cross entropy on independently corrupted true answer/padding tokens.
objective.ground_truth_mask_probability: p=(1-1e-3)*Uniform(0,1)+1e-3; divide token CE by p+1e-8.
objective.teacher: Frozen original MDLM checkpoint; no SDTT round promotion.
objective.floating_point: Float32 probability normalization and losses with bf16 mixed model execution.

trajectory.collection: Offline before optimization, one reveal per teacher forward.
trajectory.cache: Compact token/order records and bf16 inputs to the frozen teacher's final vocabulary projection, allowing logits to be reconstructed without caching per-step vocabulary tensors.
trajectory.consistency_endpoint: End of a reveal window; later windows remain masked. A fully clean sequence endpoint would make the still-masked self-consistency loss empty.
trajectory.storage_bound: 40000 * 512 * 768 * 2 = 31457280000 bytes (about 29.3 GiB) for full bf16 head-input tensors, including zero prompt rows; metadata and token records are additional. Shape estimate, not measured disk usage.
trajectory.reveal_order: Global highest-confidence eligible position per call; no contiguous token-block restriction.
trajectory.resume: Atomic tensor shards and metadata; fingerprinted manifest must be complete before training; metadata and content checksums verify resumed shards.
trajectory.cache_identity: Teacher checkpoint content hash, tokenizer serialization/vocabulary, model, training data fingerprint, selected example indices, seed, temperatures and rollout settings; relocation of identical files is allowed.

record_tensors.teacher_hidden: [512,768] bfloat16; post-final-normalization/AdaLN input to frozen output_layer.linear

trajectory.cache_read_memory: One resident shard per dataloader worker; logits reconstructed through frozen original vocabulary head.
trajectory.teacher_hidden_dtype: Only bfloat16/bf16 is supported; the normalized dtype is fingerprinted in the schema-2 cache.

selected_setup.attention: Full bidirectional MDLM attention, with no KV caching; trajectory windows do not impose a causal attention mask.
selected_setup.default_budget: 16 epochs over the offline trajectory dataset, following the author epoch count.
selected_setup.prompt_and_padding: Preserve BOS/question/literal backslash-n separator; train and corrupt answer/EOS/padding, excluding the prompt.
selected_setup.warmup_configuration: Default algo.warmup_ratio=0.05 derives warmup at runtime; lr_scheduler.num_warmup_steps=0 is a placeholder. The matched preset sets warmup_ratio=null and fixes warmup at 2500 updates.

explicit_adaptations: The released CDLM jointly changes the objective and attention architecture to block causality with KV caching; this branch keeps full MDLM attention to preserve the comparison backbone. It does not reproduce the released cached model's latency claims.
TinyGSM and the existing SmolLM tokenizer replace the released model/task/dataset mixture.
Full backbone finetuning replaces the released LoRA setup.

MMD batch 512, AdamW betas (0.9,0.999), no weight decay and EMA 0.9999 replace the release's batch/optimizer/EMA settings. The 16-epoch default keeps CDLM 5% warmup; the 20k-update matched preset uses MMD 2500-update warmup.
Compact monotone reveal-order storage replaces explicit per-step token/mask trajectory tensors.

The confidence-threshold frontier and the separate S-FLM random-position ancestral temperature-zero score are reported. Historical temperature-one val/gsm8k_acc and held-out val/answer_* diagnostics are not implemented.
A 16-epoch default and 20000-update optional budget are distinct experimental budgets; neither trajectory generation nor optimizer runtime has been measured here.
Teacher reveals the globally highest-confidence position, rather than following the release's contiguous block order; 32-reveal windows apply to the trajectory order.
The true TinyGSM Python answer supplies GT denoising, normalized over the per-example eligible span instead of a fixed 256-token generation length.

reference.evaluation: 27 thresholds: 0.325 through 0.95 in 0.025 increments, plus 0.98; greedy low_confidence_dynamic; full 512 positions; execution accuracy; mean active forwards per example.
reference.inherited_provenance_limit: Exact frozen historical source was unavailable; numeric tracker parameters and launch records are retained in the inherited record.

validation_status.gpu_training: Not run; user requested code to execute on another machine.
validation_status.distributed_gpu_or_performance: Not run; no measured speed, accuracy or pretrained parity asserted.

real_pretrained_cpu_initialization.execution: CPU only with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty and Hugging Face offline environment flags.

checkpoint_lifecycle: Save final last.ckpt with live student weights and separate EMA before final evaluation or tracker publication; final EMA frontier is evaluated if the last optimizer step was not already reported.

student_initialization.teacher: training.finetune_path remains the original raw MDLM used by the frozen teacher head and cached trajectories.
student_initialization.scope: Import strict student backbone weights only; fresh optimizer, scheduler, and student EMA; no MMD loop/optimizer history.
student_initialization.cache: Student initialization does not enter the trajectory cache identity.
student_initialization.resume: Full CDLM resume bypasses external student initialization; missing requested resume fails explicitly.

published_checkpoint.readme_reference: dlm-mmd README, Post-trained models / TinyGSM; generation_mmd_mdlm_tinygsm.sh

verified_cached_artifact.verification_scope: Inspected existing local HF cache on CPU without downloading; current remote main revision was not reverified.

published_checkpoint.network_policy: Explicit student URI opts in to Hub loading and standard HF cache lookup, even with a local teacher/tokenizer bundle. Global HF offline flags are honored. Preparation/full resume never fetch the external student.

ancestral_temperature_zero.positions: Independent Bernoulli reveals with probability (alpha_s-alpha_t)/(1-alpha_t); prompt fixed.
ancestral_temperature_zero.grid: linspace(1,1e-5,steps+1); last scheduled transition alpha_s=1; no extra final forward.
ancestral_temperature_zero.cache: ancestral_cache reuses predictions while the batch state is unchanged, for time-unconditional MDLM.
ancestral_temperature_zero.nfe: Actual shared-batch forward calls assigned to each batch member, then globally averaged over examples.
ancestral_temperature_zero.local_reference: IDLM-mdlm-large-features/tinygsm_validation.py and scripts/test_tinygsm_validation.py; equations checked against archived trainer_base.py at IDLM commit 14594e94576d3ecd752d9d4fa4458ddc20055fe7.
ancestral_temperature_zero.scope: Initial, periodic and final validation, and standalone evaluation; independent RNG from confidence decoding.
